Class OfferSpace

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.board.offerpath.OfferSpace
public class OfferSpace extends Object
Represents a single space on the offer path where a player can place their totem. Each space dictates the drafting rules for the player occupying it and may grant immediate bonuses upon placement.

  • Constructor Details

    • OfferSpace

      public OfferSpace(int positionIndex, String code, int minPlayers, int foodBonus, int topRowCardsToTake, int bottomRowCardsToTake)
      Constructs a new offer space with its specific rules and rewards.
      Parameters:
      positionIndex - The absolute physical position of the space from left to right (e.g., 1, 2, 3).
      code - The unique string identifier for the space (e.g., "A", "B").
      minPlayers - The minimum number of players required in the game for this space to be active.
      foodBonus - The immediate food bonus granted to a player when they occupy this space.
      topRowCardsToTake - The number of cards the occupying player can draft from the upper row.
      bottomRowCardsToTake - The number of cards the occupying player can draft from the lower row.

  • Method Details

    • isAvailable

      public boolean isAvailable()
      Checks if the space is currently unoccupied and available for a player's totem.
      Returns:
      True if the space is free, false if it is already occupied.

    • occupy

      public void occupy(Player player)
      Assigns a player to this space, marking it as occupied.
      Parameters:
      player - The player placing their totem on the space.

    • clear

      public void clear()
      Clears the space by removing the occupying player. This is triggered the moment a player finishes their active turn and moves their totem back to the starting tile.

    • resolveImmediateAction

      public void resolveImmediateAction(Player player)
      Resolves the immediate effects triggered by placing a totem on this space. Currently grants the intrinsic food bonus of the space to the player.
      Parameters:
      player - The player who occupied the space and receives the effects.

    • getOccupiedBy

      public Player getOccupiedBy()
      Retrieves the player currently occupying this space.
      Returns:
      The occupying player, or null if the space is empty.

    • getPositionIndex

      public int getPositionIndex()
      Retrieves the physical position index of this space on the board. Crucial for determining the new turn order at the end of the round.
      Returns:
      The integer position index.

    • getCode

      public String getCode()

      Returns:
      The string code of the space.
